parts.text: We have two posts for an Associate Professor (Maître de conférences) coming up that concern my Research Team (SocSIM-K Social Simulation and Knowledge).

The posts will be published officially at the start of March, for a start in September 2026.

If you work in the area of Agent-based Social Simulation and are interested in a permanent teaching/research post at University Grenoble Alps, France, please contact me:
Also, if you know of anyone who may be interested please feel free to forward this post.
